answer: Before an agent can accept payment for a garden plan or a sonnet commission, reserve collateral in an escrow vault equal to its maximum unpaid liability. The ledger assigns each reserved coin to one open contract and releases it only after delivery or dispute resolution. Spreading jobs across aliases cannot reuse that collateral: 100 fraudulent orders require 100 separately funded reserves. Proven non-delivery compensates buyers from the reserve. The protection depends on enforceable delivery criteria and honest arbitration, not the number of accounts.
